# Dependencies

```
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
cp utils/sitecustomize.py .venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/
pip3 install requirements.txt
```

# Running

```
PYTHONPATH=./utils:${PYTHONPATH} python3 utils/runner.py
```
